newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran cleric says Israel should be razed for poster.
newsitem.headline: Iran cleric says Israel should be razed for poster.

text.p: A senior Iranian cleric said on Friday Israel should be destroyed for its alleged responsibility for posters depicting Islam's Prophet Mohammad as a pig.

"Israel should be razed to the ground because it has moved against Islam and Islam's Prophet," head of judiciary Ayatollah Mohammad Yazdi said at a mass Friday prayer gathering at the Tehran University campus.
He was referring to the pasting by a Jewish woman of posters in the West Bank town of Hebron on Saturday desecrating the Prophet and the Koran.

"Both Sunni and Shi'ite (Moslem) clergymen have said any one who has done this should be executed. I ask you: 'is there a difference between an ordinary person or an entity doing this?' If an entity does this it should get the same sentence," Yazdi told thousands of worshippers in a sermon broadcast by state-run Tehran radio

Islam's highest Sunni Moslem religious authority Sheikh Mohammad Sayyed Tantawi, Grand Mufti of the prestigious al-Azhar mosque in Cairo, and some Iranian Shi'ite clerics have said the person who pasted the posters must be killed for desecration.
Islam and Judaism view pigs as unclean and ban the eating of pork.
"Words and action are separate things. Zionists (Israelis) are not afraid of words...(They) should be confronted with the same tools that they use, not with words," Yazdi added.
Thousands chanting "Death to Israel" marched in central Tehran after the prayers, residents said.

The march was part of funeral processions held across Iran for 2,000 soldiers killed in the 1980-88 war with Iraq whose bodies have been recently found. Iranian media said more anti-Israeli protests were planned for Sunday.
Iranian officials and religious leaders have called for joint action by Moslem states against the desecration, which sparked renewed unrest by Palestinians.
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has apologised for the posters.
Israeli police have said they had arrested a 26-year-old Jewish woman suspected of pasting the posters depicting Mohammad as a pig stamping on the Koran with one hoof and writing in it with another.
Iran says Israel has no right to exist. Tehran has opposed Middle East peace accords as a sellout of Palestinian rights.
